name: E-Commerce & Consumer Protection Compliance (FTC / EU / India)
description: Compliance framework for US FTC Act Section 5 (Unfair/Deceptive Practices), EU Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU), and India Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020, covering cancellation workflows, pricing transparency, fake review suppression, and grievance redressal officer publishing.

checklists.name: E-Commerce & Consumer Protection Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for FTC Act, EU Consumer Rights Directive, and India E-Commerce Rules 2020.

items.statement: Total purchase price (including all taxes, mandatory fees, and shipping costs) is displayed prior to final payment checkout.
Online subscription cancellation is as easy to execute online as the initial sign-up ('Click to Cancel').
EU consumers are provided 14-day right of withdrawal (cooling-off period) with model cancellation forms.
Name, contact email, phone number, and physical address of the Grievance Officer are published on the website/app.
Product reviews are verified to originate from genuine purchasers and fake/incentivized reviews are suppressed.

reviewGates.name: E-Commerce Consumer Protection Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Consumer Legal Counsel confirms that price displays, cancellation mechanics, and grievance workflows satisfy FTC and EU consumer laws.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the e-commerce audit evidence confirm full compliance with consumer protection and e-commerce regulations?
